before-starting-tree-gnome-village-while.npc: Hello, welcome to our maze. I'm Elkoy the tree gnome.

before-starting-tree-gnome-village-while.player: I haven't heard of your sort.

before-starting-tree-gnome-village-while.npc: There's not many of us left. Once you could find tree gnomes anywhere in the world, now we hide in small groups to avoid capture.
Tree gnomes have been hunted for so called 'fun' since as long as I can remember.
Our main threat nowadays are General Khazard's troops. They know no mercy, but are also very dense. They'll never find their way through our maze.

after-the-completion-of-tree-gnome-villa.npc: Hi there, I hope life is treating you well. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?

steps.text: Elkoy guides you through the maze.
The player is placed at the loose railing, the entrance to the Tree Gnome Village.

steps.npc: Here we are. Feel free to have a look around.
